Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

chromr 0.3.0

Breaking changes

  • Every reader gives the same columns: time, volume, fraction, absorbance as a280 etc. (or uv without a wavelength), then conductivity, conductivity_percent, percent_b, pressure, flow and temperature.

    • chrom_read_quadtech() names conductivity, pressure and the UV channel conductivity, pressure and uv instead of m_s_cm, psi and au, and puts the standard columns first. The values are unchanged.
    • chrom_read_ngc() gives one row per volume with a column per trace, instead of a long, grouped data frame with a volume for each trace.

  • Points not collected into a fraction have a fraction of NA, where QuadTec files record 0.

  • .find_common_start(), check_column_exist(), rename_columns() and interpolate_column() are no longer exported.

New features

  • fraction columns are a new fraction number type, created with fraction(). Fractions compare, sort and do arithmetic as numbers, and adding a number continues the numbering.

  • Absorbance columns are a new type, created with absorbance(), that records the wavelength and the unit, AU or mAU. Combining absorbance in different units converts it to mAU, dividing absorbance gives a plain ratio such as A260/A280, and plots label the axis with the unit. absorbance_convert(), absorbance_wavelength() and absorbance_unit() work with it.

  • The other columns are a new type of numbers with a unit, created with quantity(), using the unit recorded in the file: time in s, volume in mL, pressure in psi or MPa, and so on. They compare and do arithmetic with plain numbers, so volume > 10 works as before. Combining runs recorded in different units of the same kind, such as psi and MPa, converts them to the unit of the first, and plots label the volume axis with its unit. quantity_convert() and quantity_unit() work with them.

  • The readers return a chromatogram, a tibble that records the instrument, run, date, method and file, and prints them. chrom_meta() gives them.

  • chrom_fractions() gives the start and end volume of each fraction.

  • chrom_add_volume() uses the unit of the time column.

  • fraction_to_well() gives the well of the collection plate each fraction went into, as wellr well IDs.

Bug fixes

  • read_akta_old() aligns the traces by volume. They were matched by row, but each trace is recorded at its own volumes, so later in a run the values came from different volumes, up to 6 mL apart.

  • read_akta_old() ends the last fraction at a “Waste” mark, instead of extending it and warning “NAs introduced by coercion”, and reads files without injection or logbook columns. fraction_size is deprecated, as it was never used.

  • read_akta_old() reads UNICORN exports whose traces are named without the run, such as “UV” and “Gradient Concentration”, and fraction marks that name the tube, such as “T12”. It drops the run log, numbers repeated traces (a second UV trace is uv_2), warns about fraction marks it can’t read, and errors for UNICORN exports that aren’t curves, such as methods and peak tables.

  • chrom_read_quadtech() reads files whose header has been removed, and errors when the column names don’t match the data instead of giving meaningless columns.

  • chrom_append_run() continues each run from the end of all the runs before it, in the units of the first run, so a third run no longer overlaps the second. adjust_fractions = TRUE only renumbers runs whose fractions start again, and no longer warns.

  • chrom_plot_fractions() draws the fraction labels, which were never drawn, and shades the fractions in cycles of frac_labelling instead of 5.

  • chrom_plot() and chrom_plot_fractions() label the axis with the absorbance unit instead of always “AU”.

  • The fraction geoms no longer warn about points not collected into a fraction.

Minor improvements

  • chromr now requires R 4.1.0 and ggplot2 3.4.0, and no longer depends on magrittr. It suggests wellr, for fraction_to_well().

  • Errors for invalid arguments name the argument and say what’s wrong.
